[[Category:Inventory]]
'''Cycle counting''' refers to the practice of conducting frequent counts for a different small proportion of [[inventory]] each time instead of counting everything in infrequent systematic counts.

{{Hidden example}}
For a kitchen, one can choose to count eggs and cheese on Monday, vegetables on Tuesday, seasoning on Wednsday, meat Thursday, pasta and rice Friday, cakes Saturday, and bread Sunday.
{{End hidden}}

== Advantage ==

* Easier to enforce differentiated counting frequency when applying [[ABC method of inventory management]]
* Detect discrepancies and errors earlier
